scenario: Domain Runtime stopped while the Vite dev server kept running
method: Stopped the uvicorn listener on port 8000, then reloaded http://localhost:5173/
purpose: Prove a failed runtime dependency stays visible instead of being hidden behind the static catalogue.

observed.title: The landing page could not be loaded
observed.body: The Domain Runtime did not return a usable presentation. Nothing was substituted in its place.
observed.detailExplanation: The Vite proxy answers 500 when its target is down. The client reports transport failure rather than interpreting it.

assertions.claim: no silent fallback to the prepared static catalogue
assertions.evidence: No .uispec-page element and no rendered blocks. The catalogue is retained for tests only.

assertions.claim: failure is visible to the user, not swallowed
assertions.evidence: Error region exposed with role=alert and a developer-authored message.

assertions.claim: the error state is not a fallback UISpec or a repair loop
assertions.evidence: Fixed developer-authored strings. No specification was substituted, repaired or retried. The deterministic fallback specification required by CLAUDE.md rule 3 remains unbuilt (TASK-005).
